findings.title: Fluvanna Fire seeks to restore EMS authority after suspension
findings.exact_supporting_passage: The suspension has prevented volunteer personnel from providing EMS care through the department.
findings.access_consequences: Volunteer personnel at Palmyra, Kents Store, and Fork Union cannot provide EMS care through the department; paid county EMS remains fully operational.
findings.affected_population: Residents served by Fluvanna County Volunteer Fire Department companies at Palmyra, Kents Store, and Fork Union

coverage_notes: CMS Public Notices checked first; newest listed notice date remained 2026-09-30.
One late-discovered recall miss was identified: suspension of volunteer EMS authority affecting three Fluvanna County fire companies; paid county EMS remains operational.
Previously surfaced Prime Healthcare obstetric suspensions, Henderson Hospital maternity/NICU closure, and Glenwood Springs Planned Parenthood reopening were excluded as duplicates.
No approval, publication, schedule alteration, or task disablement was performed.
